name: GM MyLink (2013 Chevrolet Volt)
notes: SoC identification (Au1300, 24Kc-class MIPS32) and 800px-wide touchscreen layout (HardKeyTestDlg factory test dialog) came from decompiling the guest ROM's own AppMain.exe/MgrUSB.exe binaries, not a public datasheet.

No Au1300-specific register-level reference has been found; CP0 Config/Status values reuse the generic 24Kc-class MIPS32 defaults (QEMU target/mips/cpu-defs.c.inc, Linux arch/mips/include/asm/mipsregs.h) pending correction from real boot evidence.
